home.title: Ilona English Center
home.subtitle: English Learning Center Management Platform
home.heroTitle: Manage Your English Learning Center with Ease
home.heroDescription: Comprehensive platform for managing students, teachers, lessons, attendance, and finances all in one place.
home.featuresSubtitle: Powerful features to streamline your English learning center operations
home.feature1Description: Track enrollment, attendance, and progress for all your students.
home.feature2Description: Manage schedules, lessons, and performance metrics for your teaching staff.
home.feature3Description: Efficient attendance marking and reporting system.
home.feature4Description: Track payments, fees, and teacher salaries with detailed reports.
home.feature5Description: Get insights into your center's performance with comprehensive analytics.
home.feature6Description: Built-in chat system for teachers, students, and administrators.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Get started in three simple steps
home.step1Description: Create your account and set up your learning center profile.
home.step2Description: Invite teachers and register students to start organizing your classes.
home.step3Description: Schedule lessons, track attendance, and manage finances all from one dashboard.
home.aboutSubtitle: A supportive environment for every learner
home.aboutDescription: At Ilona English Center we combine structured lessons with real-world practice. Our teachers and modern resources help you build confidence in speaking, reading, and writing English.
home.studentLifeSubtitle: Modern classrooms and a community that supports your growth
home.ctaDescription: Join hundreds of students who are already improving their English with us. Create your account and get started today.
home.footerCopyright: © 2024 Ilona English Center. All rights reserved.
